paper.title: Algorithm 946: ReLIADiff, a C++ software package for real Laplace transform inversion based on algorithmic differentiation

field: numerics (Laplace transform inversion by algorithmic differentiation)
stack: C/C++ (netlib TOMS 946.zip: C++_files/src RELIADIFF library, demos-Linux_g++/DEMO2-Function_To_Give test driver, bundled gsl-1.15.tar.gz)

claim.text: DEMO2 default run: f_comp at x = 5.00e+00 in the shipped output_demo2.txt is 1.29653819e+00. Registered by scout from the artifact's own reference output. Tolerance 2e-8 absolute, fixed before any run.
claim.determinism: deterministic (fixed test function, default tol, sigma0 and nmax; no random input)

attempt: G1: the authors' documented route (make -f Makefile_gsl installs GSL 1.15 locally, then make -f Makefile_gslloc in DEMO2) fails in the DEMO2 util step: the utility directory's plain Makefile still points GSL at /usr/local ('No rule to make target /usr/local/include/gsl/, needed by Util.o'). The build then runs the authors' own Makefiles where they work (GSL, src, utility Makefile_gslloc) and the DEMO2 compile and link lines with GSL at ../GSL, then the authors' TEST_default.sh. The shared GSL library needs its lib directory on the loader path at run time (LD_LIBRARY_PATH; no change to the binary). No source file changed. Value 1.29653819 matches the shipped row exactly. The rest of the output differs: the elapsed-time lines (expected) and a WARNING banner present in the shipped file and absent from this run's output (see evidence/output-diff.txt). The banner is text only and not claimed.

original_attempt.reason: DEMO2 make stops: 'No rule to make target /usr/local/include/gsl/, needed by Util.o' because the utility Makefile does not take the local GSL path from the top-level target.
